widgets_values:
Generate one highly polished cinematic 16:9 action keyframe using the four supplied reference images.

REFERENCE ROLES AND PRIORITY:
Reference Image 1 provides only the industrial megacity design language: stacked container architecture, weathered concrete and metal, exposed pipes, surveillance cameras, embedded eye monitors, elevated roads and dystopian infrastructure. Do not copy its symmetrical street composition, central ramp or centered vanishing point.
Reference Image 2 is the exclusive identity, face, hair, costume and body-design reference for the female rider.
Reference Image 3 is the exclusive structural, mechanical, material and color reference for the motorcycle.
Reference Image 4 is the exclusive structure, material, color and design reference for the flying robot.

Priority:
1. Preserve character, motorcycle and robot identity.
2. Create an aggressive low-angle motorcycle chase composition.
3. Build a dense, premium daylight cyberpunk city with strong cyan–magenta–coral color separation.
4. Maintain realistic mechanical structure, cinematic lighting and commercial key-art finish.

Do not reproduce any reference sheet, collage, turnaround layout, studio background or panel division.

SCENE:
A dangerous high-speed motorcycle chase on a narrow elevated industrial highway suspended above an enormous vertical cyberpunk megacity. The world combines brutalist megastructures, stacked cargo modules, industrial service corridors, surveillance infrastructure, suspended bridges and deep cloud-filled urban voids.

This is daylight industrial cyberpunk, not an ordinary modern city and not generic neon nightlife. The image should feel technologically advanced, oppressive, dense, weathered and cinematic, with analog surveillance screens, cyan energy systems, magenta identity accents and monumental decaying infrastructure.

CAMERA AND COMPOSITION:
Use an extremely dynamic low front-left tracking camera approximately 0.35–0.45 meters above the road.
Camera is positioned very close to the front-left side of the motorcycle and looks diagonally backward and upward toward the rider.
Use an 18 mm ultra-wide cinematic lens with strong but physically believable perspective.

The motorcycle and rider dominate the left foreground, occupying approximately 55–60 percent of the frame.
Make them approximately 15 percent larger than in a conventional full-vehicle shot.

Place the oversized front wheel in the lower-left quadrant, extremely close to the lens. The wheel occupies approximately 38–42 percent of the image height and nearly touches the left and bottom frame edges.
The motorcycle body extends diagonally upward from the lower-left foreground toward the rider near the upper-left third.
The motorcycle is banking 10–15 degrees into a fast turn.

The rider’s face is located close to the upper-left rule-of-thirds point. Her face, upper torso and hands remain clearly visible and sharply focused.
Do not center the rider or motorcycle.

Reduce the amount of empty road in the lower-right quadrant. The roadway should curve and narrow rapidly toward a vanishing point slightly right of center, creating extreme speed and depth.
The road edge on the right reveals a dramatic vertical drop into a vast cloud-filled cyberpunk city canyon.

Place the flying robot behind and to the right of the rider in the middle distance, around 60–63 percent image width and 39–43 percent image height.
The robot is approximately 11–13 percent of frame height, clearly smaller than the rider.
Move the robot away from the exact center of the red sun. The robot may partially overlap the lower-left edge of the sun, but must not be perfectly centered inside it.
Show a front three-quarter view with two controlled cyan propulsion trails angled backward, indicating that it is chasing the motorcycle.
The robot remains secondary to the rider.

Place the red sun in the upper center-right, partially concealed by tall distant architecture, thin clouds and atmospheric structures.
Its diameter is approximately 18–21 percent of the frame height.
Do not show a perfectly clean isolated red circle. Give it subtle atmospheric diffusion, partial architectural occlusion and a restrained cyan rim caused by the surrounding sky.

CHARACTER AND ACTION:
Preserve the rider’s dark skin, recognizable facial identity, white braided mohawk, shaved sides, magenta-and-cyan face markings, magenta scarf, off-white armor, beige utility trousers, black gloves and matching boots from Reference Image 2.

Change her pose from upright riding to an aggressive racing posture:
she leans very low and forward over the fuel tank;
her chest is close to the motorcycle;
her shoulders angle dynamically into the turn;
both elbows are bent;
both gloved hands firmly grip the handlebars;
her knees tightly grip the motorcycle;
both feet are correctly positioned on the foot pegs.

Her head is raised while her body remains low.
She looks intensely forward and slightly toward the camera with a focused, determined expression.
Her scarf streams backward in the airflow.
The pose communicates urgency, speed, danger and skilled control, not relaxed cruising.

MOTORCYCLE:
Preserve the distinctive motorcycle from Reference Image 3:
weathered off-white body panels,
magenta structural frame and accents,
cyan headlight and wheel illumination,
transparent magenta windshield,
heavy adventure tires,
exposed mechanical engine components,
functional suspension,
correct handlebars,
correct wheel alignment,
twin rear exhausts and believable mechanical construction.

Show a dramatic front-left three-quarter view.
Emphasize the large front wheel, front suspension, illuminated cyan headlight, transparent windshield and weathered body surfaces.
Add subtle road dust, tire particles and a few sparks beneath the lower fairing.
Do not redesign it as a generic sport motorcycle, scooter or smooth science-fiction vehicle.

CYBERPUNK ENVIRONMENT:
Create a visually dense, layered city with strong vertical scale.

Left foreground:
dark weathered container architecture close to the camera;
exposed pipes, cables, steel brackets, vents and maintenance platforms;
several surveillance cameras pointing toward the road;
2–4 small embedded CRT-style eye monitors with cyan and magenta screen glow;
hard shadowed architecture framing the rider.

Middle distance:
suspended bridges crossing the city canyon;
industrial towers with external elevators, ducts and antenna structures;
stacked cargo modules;
hanging service walkways;
repeating pipes, cables, railings and mechanical details;
small controlled cyan and magenta light sources integrated into the architecture.

Right side:
a dramatic open vertical void;
layered brutalist towers receding into atmospheric depth;
floating pink-white clouds below road level;
distant suspended traffic routes and industrial bridges;
large structures disappearing into haze.

Eye screens and surveillance cameras are environmental storytelling elements only. Keep them relatively small and integrated into the architecture. Do not allow screens to dominate the image.

MATERIALS AND DETAIL:
Use premium physically based materials:
scratched painted metal,
weathered off-white composite armor,
oxidized steel,
dark gunmetal,
dusty concrete,
faded cargo-container paint,
greasy mechanical joints,
glass with controlled reflections,
translucent magenta windshield material,
subtle grime, edge wear, bolts, panel seams and accumulated road dust.

All important surfaces should have fine micro-detail and believable material separation.
Avoid smooth plastic surfaces, toy-like forms and simplified architecture.

COLOR DESIGN:
Use a sophisticated daylight cyberpunk palette with strong cool–warm separation.

Cyan and turquoise:
clear upper sky,
cool skylight,
motorcycle lighting,
robot propulsion,
screen glow,
selected architectural accents.

Magenta and fuchsia:
rider’s scarf and armor details,
motorcycle frame and windshield,
selected eye-monitor displays,
restrained reflections.

Coral red and warm peach:
the distant sun,
cloud edges,
warm atmospheric backlight,
selected highlights on the buildings.

Neutral structure:
weathered concrete gray,
dark gunmetal,
muted rust,
faded off-white,
deep charcoal shadows.

Do not cover the entire image with pink or orange haze.
Do not use a uniform sepia grade.
Keep shadows deep and slightly cool, sunlight warm, cyan illumination clean and magenta accents saturated but controlled.

LIGHTING:
Strong warm directional backlight from the upper-right red sun.
Cool cyan skylight from the upper-left and open city void.
Create crisp warm rim light around the rider’s white hair, magenta scarf, shoulder armor, windshield edge, motorcycle panels and robot silhouette.
Use cyan reflections in metal edges, motorcycle lights and shaded mechanical areas.

Increase contrast compared with a soft pastel illustration:
deep readable shadows,
bright controlled highlights,
clear silhouettes,
volumetric depth between city layers,
restrained bloom only around actual light sources.

The rider’s face must remain properly exposed, detailed and sharply readable.
No washed-out skin, no flat gray lighting and no excessive fog.

MOTION AND CINEMATIC FINISH:
Premium stylized cinematic 3D animation with realistic PBR rendering and commercial key-art quality.
Sharp focus on the rider’s face, upper body, hands, motorcycle front fairing and robot.
Use directional motion blur on:
the spinning wheels,
immediate road texture,
extreme left architectural edge,
small sparks and dust trails.

Do not blur the rider’s face, hands, motorcycle structure or robot.
Add subtle camera vibration energy, aerodynamic streaks, tire dust and controlled sparks.
Use layered atmospheric perspective without losing architectural detail.
Cinematic contrast, detailed global illumination, clean edge definition, restrained depth of field, refined color grading, polished feature-animation quality.

ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINTS:
one rider;
one motorcycle;
one flying robot;
rider and motorcycle large in the left foreground;
aggressive low racing posture;
large front wheel close to camera;
small robot behind the rider;
robot not centered inside the sun;
open vertical city canyon on the right;
dense industrial cyberpunk architecture;
strong cyan, magenta and coral color separation;
no centered composition;
no symmetrical corridor;
no central ramp;
no relaxed upright riding;
no giant robot;
no giant sun;
no empty lower-right road;
no clean ordinary daylight city;
no generic neon nightclub aesthetic;
no rain-soaked Times Square aesthetic;
no reference sheet;
no collage;
no text, captions, logos, watermarks or random letters.
